title: fix(spec,metadata-protocol): a view's packaged translation catalog yields to a published org overlay (#20731)
body:
Part of #20731. This PR lands the two producer halves that triage (5901376430) assigned to this card: the translator rule in `@objectstack/spec` and the packaged-view accessor in `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`. The card should stay open after this merges, because the `/meta` view arm in `packages/rest` still hands no base (see "Not in this PR"). Triage routes that arm onto #20730's per-type base resolver as one more arm. It is filed as a per-layer child, or added to #20730's PR, whichever the seats agree.

Clause-②: yes

## Reproduced first, at the translator and protocol layer

**Harness.** A scratch vitest file in `packages/objectql` (not committed). It builds a real `SchemaRegistry` and registers a `defineView` container the way the boot does: the container under the bare object key, then each `expandViewContainer` item under its qualified name with a package id. It uses the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` over a read-only in-memory `sys_metadata` that holds one published org overlay row: `type: view`, `name: showcase_task.in_progress`, `package_id: null`, the org, `state: active`, label `In Progress (edited-20731)`. The catalog is keyed the way the showcase ships it (`objects.showcase_task._views.in_progress.label`, zh-CN `进行中`). I did not run a real `/meta` boot. The HTTP reading is the #20680 dev's probe3 (`os-dev-report` 5900307018), and this probe reproduces it one layer down.

| reading | before (`origin/main` `33e4a5609c`) | after (this branch, rebuilt `dist`) |
|---|---|---|
| `protocol.getMetaItem` label (org read) | `In Progress (edited-20731)` | same |
| `protocol.getMetaItems` label (org read) | `In Progress (edited-20731)` | same |
| served `_packageId` | `com.example.showcase` (the artifact envelope) | same |
| `typeof protocol.getPackagedViewBase` | `undefined` | `function` |
| `translateView(served, zh-CN)`, no base | `进行中` | `进行中` (unchanged, by design) |
| `translateView(served, zh-CN)`, handed the packaged view | **`进行中`** (the base was ignored) | **`In Progress (edited-20731)`** |
| `translateMetadataDocument('view', …)` zh-CN, with base | `进行中` | `In Progress (edited-20731)` |
| the same, en, with base | `In Progress (edited-20731)` | same |
| unedited sibling `showcase_task.urgent`, zh-CN | `紧急` | `紧急` |
| after reset (no overlay row): label, then zh-CN with base | `In Progress`, `进行中` | same |

So the write and both protocol reads agree on one identity, and the protocol serves the edit. The catalog applied over it because `translateView` took no base: on `origin/main` its third parameter was `ResolveOptions`, and it never read `packagedBase`, even when the generic dispatcher passed one.

## Hypotheses (the dispatch's zone 2), and which held

- **H1: held, with one correction.** `translateView` was at `i18n-resolver.ts:906` and `translateDashboard` at `:1407`. The comparison is not written inline in `translateDashboard`. PR #20728 already made it one private function, `valueOverridesPackagedBase`, behind the exported `scalarOverridesPackagedBase`, so there was nothing to extract. `translateView` now calls that same function, so there is no second comparison. The dashboard-specific piece was the part finder `packagedDashboardPart`, the lookup that finds the packaged counterpart of a widget, filter or option by key. It is renamed to `packagedPart`, its key union is widened, and both translators share it. `translateDashboard`'s behaviour is unchanged (its 9 pins and the whole spec suite are green).
- **H2: held.** `getPackagedDashboardBase` was at `protocol.ts:7194`. The view base comes from the same source, `lookupArtifactItem`. Views are **top-level registry items**. The objectql boot loop registers each view that a `defineView` container expands to as its own `view` item, under the qualified name `OBJECT.VIEW_KEY`, with the package id; it also keeps the container under the bare object key. `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW_KEY` is only the catalog's layout, not a registry shape. The base mirrors the registry item, which is also the shape the overlay row and both reads carry. A view has no extension fold, so the artifact item is the packaged declaration.
- **H3: the key.** The catalog key is `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW_KEY.label`, derived from the served name by `viewTranslationKey`, which strips the `OBJECT.` prefix. **The base is matched by the served view's registry identity, the qualified `OBJECT.VIEW_KEY` name**, never by the bare key. The bare key is unique only within one object; the showcase ships `in_progress` views on more than one object. Pinned in `protocol-packaged-view-base.test.ts`: `showcase_task.in_progress` and `showcase_project.in_progress` each answer their own base, and the bare `in_progress` answers `undefined`. At the translator, every pin hands a qualified-name served document whose catalog sits under the bare key. I did not enumerate the example apps for a view whose registered name differs from its container key beyond the prefix. The only producer of that shape is `expandViewContainer`'s collision rename, which the build-time view-ref lint turns into a hard error.
- **H4: held, measured.** A scratch REST test (not committed) drove `GET /api/v1/meta/view/:name` and `GET /api/v1/meta/view` through `RestServer`'s real route handlers, against this branch's rebuilt `@objectstack/spec`. The protocol double served the overlaid view and implemented `getPackagedViewBase`. Results: item and list, zh-CN, `进行中`; `getPackagedViewBase` called **0** times. `packagedObjectBaseOf` in `meta-item-read-gate.ts` returns `undefined` for every type but `object`. So the defect stays observable over HTTP until the `/meta` view arm lands.

## What changes

- `translateView` takes `TranslateDocumentOptions`; it previously took `ResolveOptions`, and the new type only adds the optional `packagedBase`. When a base is supplied, the catalog replaces a string only while that string still equals its packaged counterpart. The rule is ADR-0029 D9.2a's, and it is the same one `translateObject` (#8284) and `translateDashboard` follow. It covers:
  - the view `label` and `description`;
  - each bulk-action def's `label`, `confirmText` and `confirmLabel`;
  - each param's `label`, `help` and `placeholder`.

  A def or param is matched by the `name` the bundle addresses it by. One that the base does not carry counts as authored ("a base that declares no such scalar"). With no base, the output is byte-identical to before.
- Why the bulk-action copy is included: `translateView` translates those strings too, and the rule belongs to the translator, not to one attribute. Leaving them out would mean that when the base is handed, an edited view label wins while an edited bulk-action label on the same view still loses. The measured reading is the label. The bulk-action cases are pinned but were not measured on a running app.
- `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getPackagedViewBase(name)` is the view twin of `getPackagedDashboardBase`. Both now delegate to one private `packagedArtifactBase(type, name)`: `lookupArtifactItem` and nothing wider. It is shadow-immune to an overlay hydrated under the plain registry key. It answers `undefined` for a view no code package ships, for an unknown or empty name, and for a registry that cannot answer. `getPackagedDashboardBase` answers exactly as before (its 8 pins are green).

## Readers of the changed functions, and which served answers move

- `translateView` is reached through `translateMetadataDocument('view', …)`. In the serving path, that means `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, where `translateMetaDocument` (item) and `translateMetaList` (list) pass `packagedBase: packagedObjectBaseOf(…)`. That is `undefined` for `view`, so no serving path supplies a view base today, and the new branch does not run in production until the `/meta` view arm lands. Measured: H4 above. The CLI's `i18n-bulk-action-coverage` test drives `translateView` without a base and is green (17 of 17).
- `getPackagedViewBase` has no caller yet; the `/meta` view arm will be its first reader.
- `packagedPart` and `valueOverridesPackagedBase` are private.

## Published surface (for the Clause-② line)

- `@objectstack/spec`: no export is added, removed or renamed (`check:api-surface`: "public API surface + factory signatures unchanged"). One exported function's parameter type is widened: `translateView`'s `opts` goes from `ResolveOptions` to `TranslateDocumentOptions`, and every existing call still compiles.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: one new public method, `getPackagedViewBase`, on the exported `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`.
- Both are widenings, so both changesets are `minor`, as the dispatch ordered: `.changeset/20731-spec-view-catalog-override.md` and `.changeset/20731-metadata-protocol-packaged-view-base.md`.

## No documented rule is reversed

A value equal to the packaged declaration still gets the catalog, and so does a label written as an inline locale map, because only a string counts as an override (pinned). That keeps the case `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` describes: a package's own label against its own bundle. ADR-0029 D9.2a is applied one type further; nothing is reversed.

## Tests

The code and pins below are at `a3f753cead`, which is the fix plus a merge of `origin/main` `a51920f5fb`. The only later commit, `64f4797662`, adds one ledger row to `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`. The gates are at `64f4797662`.

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts` gains a block of 12 tests:
  - the qualified-name vs bare-key identity;
  - an unedited view keeps every string translated;
  - an edited label is served in zh-CN and in `en`;
  - per-string judgement;
  - every string kind (description, the def's three strings, the param's three strings);
  - a tenant-added def or param;
  - no base as the pre-change control (the measured defect);
  - reset;
  - the ruled no-op edge and an inline locale-map label;
  - an unedited sibling view handed its own base;
  - no mutation of inputs;
  - the generic dispatcher.

  The whole spec `local` project: 576 files, 17003 passed, 1 todo.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-packaged-view-base.test.ts` has 10 tests against a real `SchemaRegistry` and the real protocol:
  - the packaged body by qualified name;
  - immunity to a plain-key overlay;
  - the key (another object's same-key view; the bare key answers `undefined`);
  - the three `undefined` answers;
  - a registry that cannot answer;
  - item and list reads serve the overlay (one identity);
  - translation with the base serves the edit in zh-CN and `en`, on item and list;
  - an unedited view stays translated;
  - the no-base control reproduces the defect;
  - reset.

  The objectql `local` project: 339 files, 6714 tests, all green.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: 190 files passed (3 skipped); 2792 tests passed (19 skipped).
- `typecheck` is green for:
  - spec, with `check:scripts-typecheck` and its test layer;
  - metadata-protocol;
  - objectql, with `tsconfig.scripts.json` and its test layer.
- **Reverse verification A** (spec, source-resolved, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`). The mutation fed `translateView` no base: `asRecord(opts?.packagedBase)` became `asRecord((opts as any)?.ABLATION_20731)`. The anchor went from 1 to 0, and the blob went from `1e7995c1148d` to `2f0943d33e2a`. `-t 20731` turned **5 of 12 red**: the edited label, every string kind, the tenant-added def or param, reset, and the dispatcher. It was restored with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The per-string test stays green under this mutation by construction: it guards the other direction, withholding too much.
- **Reverse verification B** (the same mutation, through `dist`). The spec was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 built files. The objectql protocol pins turned **2 of 10 red**: translation with the base (item and list, zh-CN and en), and reset. Restore leg: restore, rebuild, `--absent` over 230 built files, tree clean, 10 of 10 green.
- **Reverse verification C** (accessor, through metadata-protocol `dist`). `getPackagedViewBase` was made to answer the plain registry read, which is the shadow trap. After the rebuild the marker was in 2 built files, and **2 of 10** turned red: plain-key overlay immunity, and the no-code-package case. Restore leg: rebuild, `--absent` over 24 built files, tree clean, 10 of 10 green.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 96 families at `64f4797662`, and I ran all 96. Three first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` because they needed built output: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:type-check-debt`. They exited 0 after `turbo run build` over `./packages/*` and `./packages/*/*`. `--ran` reconciliation: "96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `check:engine-double-contract` asked for the new double to be recorded, so `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains one `findOne` row, written by the gate's `--write`.
- Narrowed lint: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 4 TypeScript files in the diff reported 4 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. That population comes from the config's own `files` glob, `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`; the other 3 changed paths are `.md` and `.json`. The config never enables type-aware linting (its own comment says so: no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict for an untouched file.

## Not in this PR

- **The `/meta` view arm (H4).** `packages/rest`'s item and list reads still pass no view base, so `GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress` and `GET /api/v1/meta/view` in `zh-CN` keep serving `进行中` over a published overlay until that arm lands. Triage routes it onto #20730's per-type resolver as one more arm, calling `getPackagedViewBase(name)` with the served qualified name. It is not a second resolver. #20730 is not addressed here.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` should state the view rule once the rule is observable, next to #20730's dashboard sentence.
- **The console.** I did not measure whether the console re-resolves `_views` labels client-side over the served label (the dashboard twin's acceptance notes flag that shape for widget titles). Its carrier is the `/meta` view arm's browser verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Dormant until the `/meta` arm.** With this PR alone, no served answer changes. Measured at the REST route layer (H4), not in a real boot.
- The branch merged `origin/main` at `a51920f5fb` before this PR opened. Since then, `main` has taken 3 commits (`cba417a8f2`, `0d9349fea0`, `7053333e1e`), and none of them touches these packages. The merge queue rebuilds on the current `main`.
